title: Proton Sieve filter category
description: One email category. filter/<id>.sieve is generated from this file; edits go here, not to the .sieve.

id.description: Matches the filename and the generated filter/<id>.sieve.

install_order.description: Position in the documented install sequence. Proton applies EVERY matching filter and, on conflicting actions, the LAST one wins -- so the sequence runs broad categories first and specific ones last, giving the specific filter the final say. Inside a bundle this inverts: a bundle is one script, so `stop;` makes the FIRST match win, and the generator emits bundles in reverse order to compensate. Must be unique across categories.

folder.description: Default Proton folder for this category, e.g. "Payments".

shape.description: nested: one gate with subcategory rules inside it. flat: independent top-level blocks (security, spam).

whitelist.description: extlists names checked before anything else, e.g. ":addrbook:personal".

spam_discard.description: Discard mail already on Proton's incoming spam list before filtering.

languages.description: Languages the generator emits subject keywords in. Keywords come from keyword_groups. Set to [en] for an English-only build. Over 700 non-English keywords were documented in the legacy lists and implemented in no filter at all until v0.3.0.

blocklist_folder.description: Folder that kind: block domains are filed into. Defaults to "Spam"; the phishing category uses "Phishing".

match.description: Registrable domain, no leading wildcard. The generator adds the wildcard according to `scope`.

kind.description: allow: matched into this category. block: a typosquat -- never allowlisted, emitted as a phishing rule instead. tld-example: a bare public suffix from the reference lists, never emitted, kept so nobody re-adds it. sender: a full address matched against From. ceded: another category owns this domain; see ceded_to.

scope.description: subdomains: emitted as *domain (suffix match). subdomains-only: emitted as *.domain, so a label is required in front -- required for public suffixes such as ac.uk. exact: emitted with no wildcard.

ceded_to.description: Category id that owns this domain instead. Required when kind is "ceded".

source.description: Provenance from the migration: md, sieve, or md+sieve.

folder.description: Optional subfolder this group routes to.

gate.description: True for the single top-level gate of a nested category.

op.description: How the fields below combine. A size test inside an anyof satisfies the whole gate on its own -- that bug shipped 36 times in v0.2.0, so prefer allof when a size constraint is meant to narrow.

expire_days.description: Delete timer in days. null keeps the message indefinitely. Reuse a tier from data/shared/retention.yml where one fits.

tiers.description: Nested retention tiers evaluated inside this rule.
